description: Demandes complètes de raccordements photovoltaïques en métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commission de régulation de l'énergie (CRE). Number and cumulative power (in kWp) of complete connection requests received during each quarter under the Order of 9 May 2017 concerning photovoltaic installations installed on buildings and located in metropolitan France (‘S17 PV Métropole’) for Enedis and all local distribution companies. Coverage: Commission de régulation de l'énergie (CRE). The portal shows the English title as "Complete applications for photovoltaic connections in metropolitan France" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commission de régulation de l'énergie (CRE). Its keywords include vente-en-totalite, arrete-tarifaire-du-9-mai-2017, prime-a-linvestissement, tarifs-dachat, photovoltaique, vente-en-surplus. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-04-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
